evidence: In 3d_top, 3d_iso and 3d_iso_back the relay bodies, screw terminals and driver passives are adjacent but show a visible seam between every pair, with no body intersecting or stacking on another.
Both iso views show every relay, terminal block and SMD passive seated flush on the PCB surface with no floating, sunken or tilted bodies.
In 3d_top each relay and terminal body sits over its footprint position from the 2D view, and the driver clusters and the L1/C1/C2/L2 column align with their pad locations with no displaced bodies.

Screw terminals J1-J4 sit at the bottom board edge with wire openings facing outward, relays K1-K4 form a uniform identically-oriented 1x4 row, and the diodes are oriented identically across all four channels.
Not applicable - no RF module or antenna keepout is present on this relay board.

The 2D view shows four identical, grid-aligned relay channel clusters (driver passives above each relay, terminal below) plus a tidy vertical power-filter column at the right, with no scattered or stranded parts.
